panels.title: 오늘·7일·30일 활성 사용자

targets.rawSql:
select
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where activity_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) as "오늘 (DAU)",
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where activity_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 7) as "7일 (WAU)",
  count(distinct user_id) as "30일 (MAU)"
from user_daily_activity
where activity_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 30 and user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null)

panels.description: 인증된 요청을 보낸 사용자 수(사용자당 하루 1번 기록, 토스 사용자 제외). 기록은 2026-11-03 배포부터.

panels.title: 기간 요약

targets.rawSql:
select
  (select count(*) from auth_identity where provider = 'DEVICE' and created_at >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and created_at < ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')) as "신규 설치",
  count(*) as "여정 시작",
  count(distinct user_id) as "여정 사용자",
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where status = 'COMPLETED') / nullif(count(*) filter (where status <> 'ACTIVE'), 0)) as "완료율 %"
from journey_session
where created_at >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and created_at < ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null)

panels.description: 대시보드 시간 범위 안, 토스 사용자 제외. 신규 설치 = 새 DEVICE(기기) 계정. 완료율 = 완료 / (시작 − 진행 중).

panels.title: 시간별 첫 접속 사용자
panels.description: 사용자마다 그날 첫 요청이 들어온 시각으로 센다. 그 시간에 앱을 쓴 전체 사용자 수가 아니다.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(first_seen_at,'1h',0), count(*) as "첫 접속" from user_daily_activity where first_seen_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz and first_seen_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz and user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null) group by 1 order by 1

select h.t as time, count(a.created_at) as "신규 계정" from generate_series(date_trunc('hour', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 hour') as h(t) left join auth_identity a on (a.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') >= h.t and (a.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') < h.t + interval '1 hour' and a.provider <> 'TOSS' group by 1 order by 1

select h.t as time, count(a.created_at) as "여정 시작" from generate_series(date_trunc('hour', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 hour') as h(t) left join journey_session a on (a.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') >= h.t and (a.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') < h.t + interval '1 hour' and a.user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: 시간별 경로 검색 요청
panels.description: 한 시간 구간마다 들어온 경로 검색 요청 수.

targets.rawSql:
select activity_date::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as time, count(*) as "DAU"
from user_daily_activity
where activity_date between ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date and ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date and user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null)
group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: 일별 신규 계정 (provider)

targets.rawSql:
select date_trunc('day', created_at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as time, provider as metric, count(*) as value
from auth_identity
where created_at >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and created_at < ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and provider <> 'TOSS'
group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.description: DEVICE = 앱 첫 실행 때 만드는 기기 계정 ≈ 신규 설치. TOSS 계정은 뺀다.

targets.rawSql:
select date_trunc('day', created_at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as time, status as metric, count(*) as value
from journey_session
where created_at >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and created_at < ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null)
group by 1, 2 order by 1

select date_trunc('day', created_at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as time, count(distinct user_id) as "여정 사용자"
from journey_session
where created_at >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and created_at < ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') and user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null)
group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: 일별 경로 검색 요청
panels.description: api 의 /api/route/search 요청 수(Prometheus). 사용자를 모르니 토스 요청도 섞일 수 있다(2026-10 이후 토스 활성 0). 재시작 직후 첫 건은 빠질 수 있다. 막대 하나는 그 시각부터 하루 동안의 요청이고, 마지막 막대는 지금까지의 값이다. 대략값이며 재시작 직후 요청은 조금 빠질 수 있다.

panels.title: 앱 빌드별 사용자 (기간)

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(app_build, '(알 수 없음)') as build, count(distinct user_id) as "사용자"
from user_daily_activity
where activity_date between ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date and ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date and user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null)
group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.description: User-Agent 첫 토큰. app/N = 출시 앱, Dev/N = 개발 빌드.

panels.title: 재방문 (첫 활동 주 코호트)

targets.rawSql:
with first_day as (
  select user_id, min(activity_date) as d0 from user_daily_activity where user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null) group by user_id
)
select date_trunc('week', f.d0)::date as "첫 활동 주",
       count(*) as "사용자",
       count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from user_daily_activity a
                                       where a.user_id = f.user_id and a.activity_date between f.d0 + 1 and f.d0 + 7)) as "7일 안 재방문",
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from user_daily_activity a
                                       where a.user_id = f.user_id and a.activity_date between f.d0 + 1 and f.d0 + 7)) / count(*)) as "재방문 %"
from first_day f
group by 1 order by 1 desc

panels.description: 첫 활동일 다음 날부터 7일 안에 다시 온 사용자. 최근 7일 코호트는 아직 덜 찼다.

panels.title: 사용자별 (최근 30일)

targets.rawSql:
select left(md5(a.user_id::text), 6) as "사용자",
       min(a.activity_date) as "첫 활동",
       max(a.activity_date) as "마지막 활동",
       count(*) as "활동 일수",
       (select count(*) from journey_session j
         where j.user_id = a.user_id and j.created_at >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 30)::timestamp) as "여정 수",
       max(a.app_build) as "빌드"
from user_daily_activity a
where a.activity_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 30 and a.user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null)
group by a.user_id
order by "활동 일수" desc, "마지막 활동" desc

panels.description: 사용자 id 는 md5 앞 6자로만. 목적지·좌표·이름은 싣지 않는다.

panels.title: 퍼널: 검색 → 여정 → 알림 → 완료

targets.rawSql:
with e as (
  select search_session_id from route_search_event
  where $__timeFilter(searched_at) and (user_id is null or user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null))
), j as (
  select id, search_session_id, status from journey_session
  where $__timeFilter(started_at) and deleted_at is null and kind = 'NAVIGATION' and user_id not in (select t.user_id from auth_identity t where t.provider = 'TOSS' and t.user_id is not null)
)
select
  (select count(*) from e) as "경로 검색",
  (select count(*) from j) as "여정 시작",
  (select count(*) from j where search_session_id is not null) as "검색과 이어진 여정",
  (select count(distinct n.journey_id) from journey_notification n join j on j.id = n.journey_id
     where n.channel = 'PUSH' and n.status = 'SENT') as "알림 받은 여정",
  (select count(*) from j where status = 'COMPLETED') as "완료"

panels.description: 검색 = route_search_event(V79, 2026-11-26 배포부터, 익명 포함·토스 제외, 좌표 없음). 검색과 이어진 여정 = 여정 시작 요청의 searchSessionId 가 남은 것(V80) — 배포 전 여정은 0. 단독 추적(TRACK)은 검색을 거치지 않아 뺀다.
